description: Shape Kappa Index — mean of normalised RDKit Kappa1/2/3 in [0, 1] (ChemAxon PMC11387870 convention).  Wf-252-Apply Fix #2 (F2-M6Kappa) additive metric, complementing RDKit Bickerton 2012 QED for metallodrugs.
unit: ratio (0-1, higher = more branched kappa shape)

qed_comparison.honest_framing: Shape Kappa Index is a normalised topological index, NOT a learned metallodrug score.  Paper §3 shows it side-by-side with QED.  Validation against MetalCytoToxDB labelled pIC50 deferred to a follow-up workstream.

honest_framing_note: Wf-252-Apply Fix #2 (F2-M6Kappa) Shape Kappa Index emission.  449/449 SMILES parsed (0 parse failures, gracefully skipped).  Mean = 0.4719079955824899.  Std = 0.15883008562234383.  This is the side-by-side complement to RDKit Bickerton 2012 QED; do NOT claim it as a learned metallodrug score without validation against MetalCytoToxDB labelled pIC50.
